THE ONLY CHAT THAT PAYS YOU BACK IN AIR TIME
SEATS Four camera slots per room, right on the broadcast. When they're full, a queue forms — being visible is the whole point.
THE METER Streamers set a per-second rate. It runs while your camera is live and stops the instant you leave. No subscriptions, no minimums.
BOUNTIES Want a streamer who isn't here? Stack USDC on their name with everyone else who wants them. First verified broadcast takes the pool.
NO WALL Every room is watchable without an account. Sign-up starts at the moment you want on camera, not a second before.

HOW A SEAT WORKS
01 Pick a live room Rooms mirror broadcasts already live on Twitch or Kick. Browse and watch without an account.
02 Take a seat Claim one of four camera slots at the streamer's per-second rate. Billing starts when your camera does.
03 Leave whenever Step off and the meter stops that second. Your appearance stays part of the broadcast.
